clusters.name: Jonah's move to the conservatory, 1991–1994
clusters.reason: Around Jonah starting at Wexley Conservatory in September 1991, within three years: he leaned hard on Rafe and fused with him, then a wrist injury stopped his playing and his anxiety rose with his functioning falling, a blow-up with Rafe followed, he withdrew into his room getting high and absorbed in radios, then sank further losing and low with his grandfather's death that June leaving him without footing. clusters.name: Jonah's move to Gull Harbour, 2001–2008

periods.name: the year I left home
periods.words: The first is the year I left home: I went off to the conservatory, hurt my wrist in the first term and couldn't play, dropped out and drifted at my mother's place, then spent a bleak spell at the community college shooting pool every night until an exchange in Portugal snapped me out of it and I tore through the rest of my coursework.

periods.name: the long slump
